build_ppo_agent: build a PPOAgent with configurable epochs, minibatches, value loss coefficient, and entropy coefficient for RL training
init_ppo_params: initialize PPO model parameters and RNN hidden state given an observation shape and random key
act_ppo_agent: run a JIT-compiled forward pass to get value estimates, action logits, and carry state from observations
evaluate_ppo_action: evaluate an action against the PPO policy to get log probability, entropy, and value estimates
update_ppo_model: update PPO model parameters using clipped surrogate loss, value loss, and entropy regularization across epochs
